title: Flattening a padded zip
statement: Let $a,b$ be finite bit strings and let $N$ be a natural number. For each $i=0,\ldots,N-1$, form the pair consisting of the $i$th bit of each string, using $0$ when that position is beyond the end of the string. Listing the two entries of each pair in order gives the same bit string as listing, for each $i=0,\ldots,N-1$, the $i$th bit of $a$ followed by the $i$th bit of $b$, again using $0$ beyond either string's end.
